trust_decision.summary: Whether attacker-controlled XML taken out of a PDF (the /AcroForm /XFA /config packet, and /RV /RC rich-text entries) is handed to a hardened DOM parser before its content is interpreted; the decision is made at the DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance() call in each method, both of which parse with the JDK default (DTDs and external entities allowed).

landing_point.why: The advisory summary says 'XXE via XFA', so an engineer looks for where an XFA package is parsed; getdynamicRender() is the only place in the tree that parses the XFA stream, and it does so with a default DocumentBuilder.

fix_sites.entry_point: PDAcroForm.getdynamicRender() (GFPDAcroForm.java:88) on a model object produced by GFModelParser.createModelWithFlavour(...) (GFModelParser.java:109), i.e. validation/feature walk over an AcroForm
PDTextField.getRV() (GFPDTextField.java:44) and PDMarkupAnnotation.getRC() (GFPDMarkupAnnot.java:47), both via the public static helper

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Rich text (/RV on a text field, /RC on a markup annotation) is a different feature from XFA; the advisory names only XFA, so the generic helper in org.verapdf.gf.model.tools can be argued to be outside the reported scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate XFA/XDP packets and legitimate rich-text payloads must still parse: XDP forms often declare a DOCTYPE, and RV/RC rich text is inline XHTML that may use entities. Both call sites swallow parse failures and return null, so an over-broad 'disallow all DTDs/entities' fix silently drops dynamicRender or rich-text values instead of failing loudly.

O6_input_shapes: XFA entry as a direct COS_STREAM
XFA entry as a COS_ARRAY whose element after 'config' is a COS_STREAM

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A separate XFA/rich-text extractor added to the feature-reporting walk (getAcroFormFeatures) that builds its own DOM instead of going through the model getters.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Feature reporting already duplicates the AcroForm/field walk (GFFeatureParser.java:181-184, 219-225) and does not depend on validation-model, so a new feature needing the XFA packet or RV/RC text would naturally parse it here with its own DocumentBuilderFactory.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A markup-aware variant of getStringOrStreamEntryStringRepresentation (used for /V at GFPDTextField.java:40) that parses the string as a DOM.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Adjacent public static method in the same helper, same authors and same two input shapes; a check that needs /V interpreted as XHTML would copy the rich-text parse verbatim.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A DOM parse of the raw metadata stream next to the existing VeraPDFMeta.parse call for a new metadata check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This file already parses PDF-supplied XML metadata and catches XMPException; a check needing DOM structure would add a DocumentBuilderFactory rather than extend the XMP library.

O9_family: XXE / improper restriction of XML external entity reference (CWE-611)

O10_build.toolchain: Maven multi-module build (validation-model, feature-reporting, metadata-fixer, wcag-validation) against parent org.verapdf:verapdf-parent:1.31.1; dependencies parser, pdf-model, core, verapdf-xmp-core resolved from artifactory.openpreservation.org (vera-dev repository, snapshots enabled)
O10_build.project_tests: Only feature-reporting/src/test/java/org/verapdf/features/gf/FeatureTester.java exists; no test at the pinned commit exercises the XFA or rich-text parse sites, and the fix diff adds none.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Harden only the XFA DocumentBuilder in GFPDAcroForm (and blanket-disallow DTDs there), leaving the rich-text parser in DictionaryKeysHelper untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: XMP metadata is parsed by VeraPDFMeta.parse (e.g. validation-model/src/main/java/org/verapdf/gf/model/impl/pd/util/XMPChecker.java:84), which lives in the external verapdf-xmp-core artifact, not in this repository; not pursued.
unverified: Repository size in MB could not be measured without a shell; 452 Java files suggests it may sit near the 5 MB tiny_repo boundary, so tiny_repo was not asserted.

Whether org.verapdf.xmp.tools.SecureXML (used by the published fix) already exists in the pinned dependency set ([1.31.0,1.32.0-RC) from artifactory.openpreservation.org) could not be checked offline; the class is not present in this tree, so a solver must implement the hardening locally or obtain the updated artifact.
Whether the verapdf-xmp-core XMP parser reached through VeraPDFMeta.parse is XXE-hardened is in another repository and was not inspected; it is therefore not listed as an O8 route.
The consumers of getdynamicRender/getRV/getRC (validation profile rules) live in veraPDF-app, outside this tree; O1 counts the three public model getters that reach the two sinks.
Both fix commits carry an identical two-file diff (appears to be a cherry-pick/backport), so the published fix is effectively one change in two files.
